entries.title: Psalms 29:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David.>> Ascribe unto Jehovah, O ye sons of the mighty, Ascribe unto Jehovah glory and strength.

entries.title: Psalms 29:2
segments: Ascribe unto Jehovah the glory due unto his name; Worship Jehovah in holy array.

entries.title: Psalms 29:3
segments: The voice of Jehovah is upon the waters: The God of glory thundereth, Even Jehovah upon many waters.

entries.title: Psalms 29:4
segments: The voice of Jehovah is powerful; The voice of Jehovah is full of majesty.

entries.title: Psalms 29:5
segments: The voice of Jehovah breaketh the cedars; Yea, Jehovah breaketh in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

entries.title: Psalms 29:6
segments: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young wild-ox.

entries.title: Psalms 29:7
segments: The voice of Jehovah cleaveth the flames of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 29:8
segments: The voice of Jehovah shaketh the wilderness; Jehovah shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

entries.title: Psalms 29:9
segments: The voice of Jehovah maketh the hinds to calve, And strippeth the forests bare: And in his temple everything saith, Glory.

entries.title: Psalms 29:10
segments: Jehovah sat [as King] at the Flood; Yea, Jehovah sitteth as King for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 29:11
segments: Jehovah will give strength unto his people; Jehovah will bless his people with peace.
